subject: Stopgap bridge offer and short pilot extension negotiation
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@helix.ai>, Sarah Lopez <sarah@helix.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stopgap: short pilot extension and bridge offer

Hi Tom / Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo last week and for getting the team hands-on with Redwood. We reviewed the usage from days 1–7 (attached) and we hear you on the need for a little more runway to finish the reranker validation.

To keep momentum, we can offer a short "stopgap" bridge: a 14-day extension to the existing time-boxed pilot plus the following commercial concessions so your engineers can finish the validation without interruption:
- 20% off the per-token rate for the extension window (applied to tokens consumed during the 14 days)
- one week (40 hours) of engineering office hours from our inference performance team to tune batching/latency on your dataset

I've attached the updated SOW (POC_SOW_v2.pdf) and the usage report. If that sounds workable I can sketch a 1-paragraph amendment and send for DocuSign today. Alternatively, if your procurement prefers credits instead of a time-based extension, say so and we can convert the concession to a credit bucket.

Suggest next step: confirm preferred structure (time extension + discount vs. credits + support) and I'll loop in Legal/Finance for the amendment.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC_SOW_v2.pdf, usage_report_6-10.csv

From: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@helix.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah@helix.ai>
Cc: procurement@helix.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 12:04:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Stopgap: short pilot extension and bridge offer

Thanks Avery — appreciate the quick follow. Quick Qs:
1) Can you convert the 20% concession into a credit bucket instead (our CFO prefers credits over date-based extensions)? If so, how many credits would correspond to the expected token consumption for 14 days?
2) Our team needs a clear success criteria to justify a conversion to purchase: can you include an objective metric (e.g., reranker MAP delta or p95 response latency target) tied to the engineering hours?

Looping procurement to get visibility on process timelines (procurement@helix.ai). If we can get an amendment today that both Legal and Procurement can sign quickly, we can keep the evaluation active and target a conversion decision within 30 days of the extension end.

—Tom
Tom Reilly
Head of Search, HelixAI
tom.reilly@helix.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@helix.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Stopgap: short pilot extension and bridge offer

On Thu, Jun 10, 2027 at 12:04 PM Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@helix.ai> wrote:
> Can you convert the 20% concession into a credit bucket instead (our CFO prefers credits over date-based extensions)?

Tom — we can do credits. Rough calc: based on the attached usage, we expect ~1.9M tokens over the 14-day window at current test load. At list rate that equates to ~$2,800; a 20% concession converts to ~$560 of credit. To give operational headroom and avoid a mid-run top-up, we propose rounding to an even credit bucket: $1,000 equivalent credits (applies only to pilot traffic) + 24 hours of engineering support (instead of 40) focused on batching and KV-cache priming.

If Helix wants stronger guarantees, we can offer the alternative: 14-day extension + 15% discount + 40 hours of support, but that requires a lift on procurement timelines for a quick amendment.

Also agree on the success criteria ask: we'll propose two objective gates for the amendment:
- Reranker: > +5% relative MAP on your holdout (as measured against baseline run in usage_report_6-10.csv)
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 220ms for production-sized requests under the configured batching profile

If those gates are satisfied during the extension window we will apply a convertor credit of 5% of the first paid month invoice as a rebate toward the committed term. I'll let Avery follow up with the DocuSign amendment.

Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0120

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah@helix.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@helix.ai>
Cc: procurement@helix.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:12:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Stopgap: short pilot extension and bridge offer

Thanks Ben — that split helps. A few comments from our side:
- Credits: Helix prefers the credit bucket (less contract friction). $1,000 is acceptable as an interim bucket, but with our expected burst pattern we will likely burn through that in ~10 days. Could you do $8k credits instead? That gets us comfortably through peak runs and removes the need for mid-run approvals.
- Support hours: 24 hours is fine but we ask those be scheduled across the 14-day window (not front-loaded) and include a short deliverable (tuned batching recipe + a one-page tuning summary).
- Success criteria: we agree to the MAP gate but would prefer p95 <= 200ms vs 220ms — our ops target is tighter. If you can meet 200ms we can commit to a 30-day paid conversion with a 5% conversion rebate as Ben proposed.

Attaching procurement's note for visibility (procurement@helix.ai included). If Redwood can confirm $8k credits + 24 hours scheduled across the run and the 200ms latency target, we'll aim to approve the amendment on our side within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Sarah Lopez
Principal ML Engineer, HelixAI
sarah@helix.ai

Attachment: procurement_note.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah@helix.ai>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@helix.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement@helix.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:43:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Stopgap: short pilot extension and bridge offer — final offer

Sarah / Tom — appreciate the clarity and the procurement note. We can accept Helix's ask with the following final stopgap amendment:
- 14-day extension to current pilot window
- $8,000 credit bucket applied to pilot usage (only during the extension window)
- 24 hours of engineering support from our inference team, scheduled across the 14 days, deliverable includes tuned batching recipe and one-page tuning summary
- Performance gate: reranker MAP >= +5% and p95 inference latency <= 200ms as measured against the agreed baseline run
- Conversion incentive: if Helix converts to a paid committed term within 30 days of the extension end, Redwood will apply a 5% rebate to the first paid month invoice. Additionally, if Helix signs a 3-month minimum commit within that window, Redwood will apply a one-time 12% discount to month one.

I've attached a short amendment and DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-def456. Please review; if Procurement can sign within 48 hours we'll stand up the extension immediately. If you want the concession packaged as a short invoice-credit instead of DocuSign, let us know and we'll route through Finance.

Can you confirm which path you prefer (DocuSign amendment vs invoice-credit) and who will be the signer on Helix's side?

Thanks — we'll standby to schedule the engineering hours once signed.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
